# Copilot instructions

Project: GitHub organization profile repository (README, SECURITY, license).

Full cross-tool rules: `.ai/rules/project.md` (read it first).

## Essentials

- Write all code, comments, commit messages and documentation in English.
- Fix every error you meet, also outside the request.
- Never add dependencies or secrets; follow the sibling files of the area you change.
- `README.md` is the public face of the project: keep it accurate, short and consistent with the other repositories.
- Never include secrets, internal hosts or customer data.

## Commands

- No build step.
